comment: "What I found most interesting about this course was the application of epidemiological principles to identify, analyze, and prevent patient safety incidents. The way concepts like incidence, prevalence, and risk factors were linked to real-world clinical errors made the subject highly practical and relevant."

"What a great refresher course for me. I found all aspects of this course interesting. I particularly took notes while going through root cause analysis (RCA), and failure mode and effect analysis (FMEA). I absolutely love how they were both explained."

"The most interesting aspects of the course were learning from real clinical cases, understanding human factors and system-based errors, and seeing how simple safety checks can prevent serious patient harm."
"I liked the part focusing on analyzing medical errors in order to prevent them from occurring again."
"I liked the interactive discussion and real world application and theory."
"I found this course very illuminating and refreshing."
